scripts.setup: bun install && bun run db:up && bun run migrate:install-tool && bun run swagger:install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.swagger:gen: go -C apps/api run github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag init -g cmd/api/main.go --output swagger
scripts.dev:backend: bun run swagger:gen && cross-env GO_ENV=development go -C apps/api run ./cmd/api
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env PORT=4000 bun run --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:frontend
scripts.start:frontend: cross-env PORT=4000 bun run --cwd apps/web start
